rules_teleportation: Moves a piece to any square on the board, ignoring obstacles.
rules_imune: Makes a piece invulnerable to enemy attacks for one turn.
rules_rollback: Undoes a piece's actual move, sending it back to where it came from. Impossible on the king.
rules_clone: Creates a copy of a piece on an adjacent empty square. Only possible if the target has an adjacent empty square.
rules_morph: Turns a piece into another one: for one turn if the target is an enemy, for two turns otherwise.
rules_canceller: Cancels the effect of an enemy skill used on the previous turn. The list of the enemy's skills from the previous turn is offered so you can choose which one to cancel.
rules_tornado: Moves every piece on the board in a rotating direction, except the kings.
rules_invisibility: Makes a piece invisible for two turns.
rules_freeze: Prevents an enemy piece from moving for two turns.
rules_terminator: Creates, for one turn, a copy of a random enemy piece with all its abilities, placed on the same square but on your side of the board. If the square is not available, the operation is impossible.
rules_destiny_swapper: Swaps the positions of two allied pieces.
rules_trap: Sets a trap on an empty square that immobilizes the first enemy piece stepping on it for two turns. Every move is a sequence of square-by-square steps: a trap on the path stops the piece on the trap's square.
rules_bench: For one turn, the piece is put on the bench (it is no longer on the board). When it returns, it is placed on the free square nearest to its former square.
rules_forcefield: Applied to a piece: when it is captured, the attacker is pushed back by up to two squares. The captured piece goes to the graveyard: it is not invincible.
rules_transposition: Swaps the position of two pieces on the board, without causing a check.
rules_queensac: In case of checkmate, swaps the queen with the king. The queen DIES on the king's square.
rules_temporal: Lets an allied piece go back in time and redo its last move. Impossible on the king.
rules_geomancy: Changes the layout of the board by moving squares to create walls that block the opponent for three turns.
rules_celestial: Once per game, prevents an allied piece from being captured and puts it back on its starting position. Impossible on the king.
rules_godhelp: A piece appears at random on the board, with random abilities, for three turns. It does not belong to the base board; neither the spawn square nor the type can be chosen.
rules_remover: Removes one pawn from among the opponent's pawns. Impossible if the removal causes a checkmate.
rules_wall: Brings pawns (and only pawns) back to life as a protective wall. They are playable from the next turn. If they die again, they cannot be brought back with another skill.
rules_mirage: Simulates a piece on the board (not the king). If it dies, it vanishes. It can neither cause a checkmate nor capture pawns, and it blocks a move unless that move is a king move.
rules_evolve: Evolves a pawn as if it had stepped onto an evolution square of an enemy board. Usable on all pieces, except the king.
rules_switch: Makes an enemy piece with no range or line of sight change sides. Impossible on a piece that causes a checkmate.
rules_mind: Gives the best possible move, three times in the game, whenever the player wants.
rules_control: Takes control of an enemy piece for one full turn, as if it were one of your pieces. Does not work on the enemy king.
